name: a rel write no longer drops the filter-result cache
why: Reverts the fix to the shipped-on-branch behaviour, where _relScheduleProgressRefresh() dropped only the uniq-dropdown cache. _buildFilterKey() hashes filter INPUTS alone, so picking the same 📊 relationship entry after another row has been hand-loaded builds an identical key and _filterResultCache replays the earlier row list — the second row is removed from the DOM rather than re-tested. The spec must fail on the rendered row count (2 expected, 1 rendered) while the dropdown's own count still reads 2, which is what separates a replayed filter result from a stale dropdown.
grep: picking the entry again after loading a second matching row includes both rows
